scientific.integrity: The analytic types are proved from exact local jets and an exhaustion argument for rank-three Hessian singularities. Literature-derived premises and new deductions are distinguished explicitly.
limitations: The full primary decomposition of the Hessian 3x3-minor ideal is taken from arXiv:1909.12538; the bundled checker verifies the exceptional fibers and all new local calculations but does not rederive that complete decomposition.
The statement is over C and only for the two roots of 9 rho^2 - 14 rho + 9.
An equivalent ADE description may exist in older cubic-surface literature under different normal forms; no such statement was found in the inspected sources.

title: A \(7A_1+3A_3\) Hessian quartic at the exceptional \(3A_1\) cubic parameters
